question: What distinction is claimed for the liṅga at Vatsahatantu among all liṅgas?
premises: There is a liṅga at Vatsahatantu
It is compared to all liṅgas
It is called best of the best
inference: The liṅga at Vatsahatantu is the best of all liṅgas.
uncertainties: The form vatsa+hatantu is obscure and may be a place name
plain_english: At Vatsahatantu is the liṅga that is the best of all liṅgas.
